verdict.rationale: Docs confirm cubic auto-reviews every new PR (cubic-docs-1) and that cubic.yaml governs 'PR descriptions' as part of AI review behavior (cubic-docs-11), and a community reviewer notes it gives more technical explanations than plain review tools (cubic-comm-1), implying some auto-generated summary content. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'PR summary/change walkthrough' artifact (like a structured diff walkthrough comment) separate from inline review comments and fixes. Missing for 10: explicit description/example of a standalone auto-generated PR summary or walkthrough feature, and independent hands-on confirmation of its content/format.
